Approval is recorded once with actor, date and a neutral statement. Later scope revisions are recorded, never re-approved; final review derives revisions from change.toml history. Exact content evidence remains mandatory.

updates.statement: Ready, admission, continuation and final require approved source authority and intact committed journal ancestry. Observations never block; pending and deferred observations appear in final unfinished_work. Record requires a summary and optional requirements; resolve requires an observation and reason, with optional evidence.

decisions.reason: The owner approved the thinner protocol on 2026-11-10. The measured friction supports recording scope and observations instead of refusing. Retain authorization before implementation, exact evidence, fully validated integrated delivery, explicit delivery authority, isolated workspaces with explicit merge resolution/trailers, and exclusive clause ownership. Keep stacking and cleanup. Reject retaining contract re-approval and owed-node discharge because they add process cost beyond these invariants. Reopen if the retained invariants cannot be established. Resource scheduling, concurrency, environment preparation and test selection belong to repository configuration and the operating model.
